scope: Public-resource directory snapshot. Individual review dates and limitations remain attached. Access and destinations can change. Inclusion is not a product test, partnership or permission to use tools during play.

entries.title: Poker hand rankings
entries.description: A quick lookup for traditional high-hand rankings and how tied hand categories are compared.

entries.title: Poker terms glossary
entries.description: Look up the language used in hand histories and commentary without following a full course.

entries.title: Pokerology poker lesson library
entries.description: A structured index of lessons on the rules, betting, hand reading, poker mathematics and study topics.
entries.notes: Public lesson catalogue inspected, not every lesson. Historical instruction and commercial links need context.

entries.title: PokerStars Learn overview
entries.description: An entry point to the operator's learning articles, courses, quizzes, and basic references.
entries.notes: Access requirements can differ for linked interactive features.

entries.title: Texas hold'em from deal to showdown
entries.description: An introduction to blinds, betting streets, community cards, and the different betting structures.

entries.title: The Hendon Mob beginner guides
entries.description: Introductory reading paths for hold'em, Omaha, stud, and split-pot games.
entries.notes: An older educational collection. Treat older commercial references as historical, not current offers.

entries.title: David Parlett: a history of poker
entries.description: Explore the development of poker and competing origin accounts through a signed essay that identifies historical references.
entries.notes: Originally published in 2005. A historical interpretation with sources, not an exhaustive account of modern poker.

entries.title: Home Poker Tourney printable rulebook archive
entries.description: A landing page for home-tournament rulebook formats, printable references and instructions for producing a booklet.
entries.notes: Historical archive includes 2013 TDA rules, not the current tournament rules. Landing page reviewed; linked PDFs not inspected.

entries.title: Home Poker Tourney: chips and starting distributions
entries.description: A practical discussion of denominations, starting stacks, rebuys and chip quantities for a small home tournament.
entries.notes: Examples use particular tournament sizes and chip conventions. This is planning context, not a universal purchase recommendation or legal guide.

entries.title: Poker Chip Forum
entries.description: Community discussions of poker chips, home-game equipment, and game organization.
entries.notes: Marketplace posts are not vetted recommendations. Public reading and member participation differ.

entries.title: Poker TDA rules discussion forum
entries.description: Browse rules questions and scenario discussions hosted by the tournament directors' association.
entries.notes: Forum interpretations are not automatically adopted rules or binding event decisions. Posting may require registration.

entries.title: Two Plus Two forums
entries.description: Public discussions of poker strategy, hands, software, and the wider game.
entries.notes: Community claims are not editorially verified. Posting may require an account; keep private hand details out.

entries.title: Asia Pacific Poker Tour: official event hub
entries.description: Official starting point for APPT event information and links to individual stops.
entries.notes: Free refers to reading the page, not participating. Dates, eligibility and registration conditions need an event-specific check.

entries.title: Asian Poker Tour series
entries.description: Official series information, reports, and routes to tournament rules.
entries.notes: This directory does not copy or guarantee event dates or prize details.

entries.title: European Poker Tour schedule
entries.description: Official EPT event pages and festival information.
entries.notes: Dates and local event requirements should be reconfirmed before travel.

entries.title: Irish Poker Open: official event hub
entries.description: Organizer-controlled entry point for festival information, schedules and event updates.
entries.notes: The public hub was inspected, not bookings or entry eligibility. Check the specific year, structure, terms and latest organizer updates before making plans.

entries.title: King's Resort: official poker information
entries.description: Operator information for poker events and schedules, adding a European cardroom source to the directory.
entries.notes: A source for event confirmation, not a travel recommendation. Recheck venue, year, structure and entry conditions with the organizer.

entries.title: MSPT events and tournament information
entries.description: Follow the tour's event listings to festival schedules, venue information and tournament coverage.
entries.notes: Use the organizer's current event page rather than treating this directory as a copied calendar.

entries.title: PokerGO Tour
entries.description: Official high-roller tour information, events, coverage, and standings.
entries.notes: Event information is distinct from access to a paid broadcast.

entries.title: Thunder Valley poker information and events
entries.description: The cardroom's source for tournament series, daily events, poker updates and links to event details.
entries.notes: Check the exact event and structure with the room before acting. No copied schedule, travel advice or guarantee of availability.

entries.title: Venetian DeepStack tournament series
entries.description: Navigate the organizer's DeepStack festivals, event schedules, structure sheets and results links.
entries.notes: Series pages can change. Verify final event terms directly; linked PDFs were not independently audited.

entries.title: World Poker Tour schedule
entries.description: Find the tour's events and follow links to the corresponding festival details.
entries.notes: Use this live source rather than a copied date list when making plans.

entries.title: WSOP and Circuit schedule
entries.description: The organizer's schedule for bracelet, Circuit, and Super Circuit events.
entries.notes: Schedules change. Confirm the exact event, structure, and registration details with the organizer.

entries.title: Wynn Las Vegas poker schedules and structures
entries.description: Find the room's tournament information, festival schedules, structure links and poker frequently asked questions.
entries.notes: Public landing page inspected. Linked structure PDFs and individual dates require their own current check.

entries.title: A beginner's guide to poker combinatorics
entries.description: Learn how counting specific card combinations supports range analysis.

entries.title: Equity realization: why raw equity is not enough
entries.description: Connect showdown equity to expected value while considering position, future betting and whether a hand reaches showdown.
entries.notes: Examples depend on their ranges and game tree. This is a conceptual explanation, not a result for your own hand.

entries.title: Expected value: outcomes weighted by probability
entries.description: Introduces expected value through a coin example and a poker example, separating it from raw equity.
entries.notes: Teaching examples simplify the situation. Check payoff definitions, probabilities and future betting before applying a calculation to a recorded hand.

entries.title: Implied odds: price versus future payments
entries.description: An introduction to the additional money a draw may win on later streets, with examples and a calculation.
entries.notes: Future payments are assumptions, not guaranteed returns. A completed draw may still lose; the examples do not model every opponent response or house charge.

entries.title: Introduction to stack-to-pot ratio
entries.description: Connect the remaining effective stack to pot size before discussing a postflop decision.

entries.title: MIT: Poker Theory and Analytics (2015)
entries.description: A course on poker theory and analytical decision-making, with lecture notes, videos, assignments, and solutions.
entries.notes: Historical course material, not a current software guide or a profitability guarantee. Course catalogue inspected; lessons were not completed.

entries.title: Pot odds step by step
entries.description: A worked introduction to converting the price of a call into a percentage.

entries.title: What effective stack size means
entries.description: An explanation of which stack limits the amount two players can contest.

entries.title: Gamblers Anonymous: peer support and meetings
entries.description: Organization information and routes to in-person, virtual and telephone peer-support meetings.
entries.notes: Peer support is not poker coaching or an emergency service. Meeting details and availability should be checked with the organization.

entries.title: GamCare gambling support and recovery resources
entries.description: Find gambling-harm support, online community options and routes to support services in England and Scotland.
entries.notes: Regional support information, not poker-performance coaching. Check the provider's eligibility and current contact options.

entries.title: National Council on Problem Gambling help
entries.description: An official starting point for finding gambling-related support and treatment information.
entries.notes: Support resources are separate from performance coaching; use the current contact options on the source page.

entries.title: The Mental Game of Poker: author information
entries.description: The author's description of a book about tilt, confidence, motivation, and coping with variance.
entries.notes: A book listing, not treatment advice or verification of the author's effectiveness claims.

entries.title: Variance and bankroll context
entries.description: Background reading on variability in results and the role of assumptions in risk discussions.
entries.notes: Educational context, not a personalized bankroll recommendation or a reason to increase spending.

entries.title: AIVAT: reducing variance in agent evaluation
entries.publisher: Burch, Schmid, Moravcik, and Bowling / arXiv
entries.description: The authors' paper on evaluating agents using value estimates and known strategies to reduce outcome variance.
entries.notes: Abstract and metadata inspected, not a full-paper audit or replication. The listed method has information and modeling requirements.

entries.title: AV-AIVAT: variance reduction with sequential stopping
entries.description: A 2026 preprint combining AIVAT with confidence sequences for deciding when an agent evaluation has enough evidence.
entries.notes: Abstract and metadata only. Its asymptotic results and finite-sample guarantees are distinct; headline efficiency claims were not replicated.

entries.title: Counterfactual regret minimization: original paper
entries.description: The 2007 publication introducing counterfactual regret and a method for solving large imperfect-information games.
entries.notes: Publication page and abstract read, not a proof audit or reproduction. Equilibrium conclusions require the paper's game assumptions.

entries.title: Deep Counterfactual Regret Minimization
entries.publisher: Brown, Lerer, Gross, and Sandholm / arXiv
entries.description: The authors' research-paper landing page for using neural function approximation with counterfactual regret minimization.
entries.notes: The abstract and metadata were checked; this listing is not a new replication or full-paper review.

entries.title: DeepStack: imperfect-information reasoning in poker
entries.description: Research on recursive reasoning, decomposition, and learned value estimates in heads-up no-limit hold'em.
entries.notes: Abstract and metadata inspected. Heads-up research is not a six-player tournament solution or a verified product recommendation.

entries.title: Introduction to counterfactual regret minimization
entries.description: Teaching material and exercises introducing regret minimization with small games, including Kuhn poker.
entries.notes: A foundational educational resource. Small-game examples do not solve full multiplayer tournament poker.

entries.title: Libratus: architecture and heads-up no-limit poker
entries.publisher: IJCAI / Noam Brown and Tuomas Sandholm
entries.description: The authors' 2017 proceedings page outlines blueprint computation, nested subgame solving and self-improvement.
entries.notes: Abstract and publication record read. The reported game is heads-up no-limit hold'em; this is not a multiplayer tournament solution or an implementation test.

entries.title: Monte Carlo CFR: sampling and regret
entries.description: The 2009 paper introducing a family of sampling-based CFR algorithms, including outcome and external sampling.
entries.notes: Publication page and abstract read. Expected updates and convergence guarantees do not certify a particular finite training run.

entries.title: OpenSpiel documentation
entries.description: A research framework for games and learning algorithms, including imperfect-information settings.
entries.notes: A general research toolkit, not a ready-made tournament strategy recommendation.

entries.title: Pluribus: six-player poker research explained
entries.description: The research institution's 2019 account of Pluribus, its six-player experiments and limited-lookahead search.
entries.notes: Institutional research summary, not the full proof or a reproduced experiment. Reported performance is distinct from solving every multiplayer game or payout format.

entries.title: Poker Hand History file format specification
entries.description: A human-readable, machine-parsable format for recording poker hands across variants, with required fields, notation, and examples.
entries.notes: The format documents records; it cannot establish that a hand actually happened. Keep private participant details out of shared examples.

entries.title: Poker hand-history research dataset: version 3
entries.description: A versioned PHH dataset catalogue combining benchmark hands and historical collections, with source and file information.
entries.notes: Catalogue only; the large archive was not downloaded. Check provenance, licensing, and duplicate-hand warnings before analysis.

entries.title: PokerKit documentation
entries.description: Documentation for a Python library covering poker game simulation, hand evaluation, and analysis.
entries.notes: Research and development resource. Its implementation was not audited for this directory.

entries.title: RLCard environments and learning algorithms
entries.description: A research toolkit with card-game environments, including Leduc and hold'em, and examples of learning algorithms.
entries.notes: Documentation inspected; no installation or code audit. Check the particular environment's rules and action abstractions.

entries.title: Treys Python hand-evaluator repository
entries.description: Read the project's usage examples for representing cards and evaluating five-, six- and seven-card poker hands.
entries.notes: README and repository landing page inspected. Code was not executed or audited; check licensing, tests and maintenance before reuse.

entries.title: University of Alberta computer poker publications
entries.description: An original research-group archive linking papers and abstracts on Cepheus, DeepStack, evaluation and game solving.
entries.notes: Historical publication archive, not a current product list. The Cepheus result concerns heads-up limit hold'em, not every form of poker; linked papers were not all audited.

entries.title: Card Player tournament schedules and results
entries.description: Search tournament listings and reported results across series.
entries.notes: A secondary listing is a discovery aid. Confirm event details with the organizer.

entries.title: Poker.org reporting
entries.description: Poker reporting, interviews, and industry coverage from the publisher.
entries.notes: Individual articles have their own dates, sources, and commercial context.

entries.title: PokerAtlas Las Vegas room and tournament finder
entries.description: Compare Las Vegas poker-room listings and discover tournament information in one regional directory.
entries.notes: A secondary listing, not the organizer. Confirm schedules and game availability with the room; reviews are user contributions.

entries.title: PokerNews live reporting
entries.description: Follow reported hands, chip updates, and tournament coverage from current and past events.
entries.notes: Reporting is selective and can be corrected; it is not a complete hand-history dataset.

entries.title: Seminole Hard Rock Hollywood poker coverage
entries.description: The room's tournament blog provides event reports, seat draws, payouts and links into its series coverage.
entries.notes: Public reporting is selective and may be revised. Reported prizes and chip counts are not a player's net profit.

entries.title: The Hendon Mob results database
entries.description: Find recorded live tournament results, festivals, venues, and player records.
entries.notes: Listed winnings are not net profit, a complete financial record, or proof of ability.

entries.title: Asian Poker Tour tournament rules
entries.description: The tour's published tournament rules, useful alongside an event's structure sheet.
entries.notes: Check the rules for the actual event; another tour may handle a situation differently.

entries.title: Pagat: betting, table stakes and showdown
entries.description: Compare betting structures, antes and blinds, table stakes, side pots and showdown conventions across poker games.
entries.notes: General and home-game conventions are included. They do not override a venue's current rules or staff ruling.

entries.title: Poker betting, actions, and showdown
entries.description: A reference for betting actions, dealing, and deciding the winner at showdown.
entries.notes: Educational page on a commercial poker operator's website.

entries.title: Poker TDA rules and procedures
entries.description: Tournament rules, recommended procedures, and examples from the association that publishes them.
entries.notes: Directly read the official 2026 rules, version 1.0 dated September 7, 2026, including procedures and the addendum. TDA rules supplement house rules; applicable agency rules take precedence.

entries.title: PokerStars cash-game rake schedules
entries.description: An operator's public explanation and tables for cash-game rake and caps.
entries.notes: Rates vary with game, stakes, players and region. This is not a live-cardroom fee table; consult the applicable current terms rather than copying a rate into another game.

entries.title: PokerStars Live tournament rules
entries.description: Operator-specific live tournament procedures, player responsibilities, and restrictions.
entries.notes: These are this operator's rules, not permission to film or use software at every venue.

entries.title: D&B Poker book catalogue
entries.description: Publisher descriptions for poker books, ebooks, audiobooks, and selected companion material.
entries.notes: Choose by topic and edition. No prices, purchase recommendation, or pirated copies are reproduced.

entries.title: GTO Wizard article library
entries.description: Explanations of ranges, expected value, tournament models, and ways to organize solver study.
entries.notes: Provider-written teaching material, not an independent test of its software.

entries.title: Modern Poker Theory: publisher overview
entries.description: Publisher description of a no-limit hold'em text centered on GTO concepts and software-assisted analysis.
entries.notes: Publisher information inspected, not the full book. Promotional claims are not independent evidence; check the edition and sample before buying.

entries.title: Play Optimal Poker: author introduction
entries.description: The author introduces a game-theory-focused book series built around poker decisions and strategic reasoning.
entries.notes: The public description was read, not the complete books. Access refers to the books; this is not a hands-on review, price guarantee or claim of improved results.

entries.title: PLO Mastermind article library
entries.description: Find Omaha-focused articles on hand selection, postflop ideas and differences among four-, five- and six-card games.
entries.notes: Free blog articles are distinct from paid training and solver products. Product claims were not tested.

entries.title: PokerCoaching strategy blog
entries.description: Strategy articles and hand discussions covering tournament and cash-game decisions.
entries.notes: The public blog is distinct from paid coaching memberships.

entries.title: Red Chip Poker learning hub
entries.description: A route into free strategy guides and discussion, alongside structured paid courses.
entries.notes: The directory does not endorse the provider's performance claims.

entries.title: Run It Once training and discussions
entries.description: Courses, professional training videos, and discussion areas for hold'em, tournaments, and Omaha.
entries.notes: Membership or a separate purchase is required for much of the training library.

entries.title: SplitSuit strategy and study resources
entries.description: Cash-game articles, videos, and study material, with routes to courses and workbooks.
entries.notes: Free material and paid products coexist; select the resource that answers your question.

entries.title: The Mathematics of Poker: a critical reader's review
entries.description: A signed review discussing the demands of Chen and Ankenman's book and the step from toy games to poker.
entries.notes: A historical, subjective review, not access to the book itself. Read it to assess prerequisites, not as a verified ranking of all poker books.

entries.title: The Poker Bank: organized hold'em strategy library
entries.description: A topic-organized archive covering position, betting, mathematics and cash-game concepts, with named contributors.
entries.notes: Some material is historical and the site carries gambling promotions. Review assumptions and publication dates; inclusion does not endorse its operator promotions or profit claims.

entries.title: Upswing strategy article library
entries.description: Browse strategy articles by experience level, cash games, tournaments, live play, or online play.
entries.notes: The articles are free; courses and other products are separate paid offerings.

entries.title: Card Player hold'em odds calculator
entries.description: The public interface lets readers specify hold'em cards and board information for an equity calculation.
entries.notes: Interface and instructions inspected, not calculation accuracy. Known-card equity is not a recommendation against an unknown range; study after play.

entries.title: Flopzilla range analysis
entries.description: Inspect how a proposed range connects with a board and compare equity and combination displays.
entries.notes: Provider description only. Check platform support and licensing before buying.

entries.title: GTO Wizard Study Mode documentation
entries.description: Learn how the study interface specifies a spot and displays its solution.
entries.notes: Documentation is free to read; software access is separate.

entries.title: GTO Wizard study platform
entries.description: A provider overview of its study, practice, hand-analysis, and solving tools.
entries.notes: Features and access vary by plan. No software performance or solution quality was tested here.

entries.title: GTO+
entries.description: Provider information for a game-theory study solver and its analysis workflow.
entries.notes: Check the current license and supported configuration. Study use only.

entries.title: HoldemResources Calculator
entries.description: The provider's entry point for preflop and postflop tournament and cash-game analysis.
entries.notes: Paid software with trial information. Review required inputs and model scope before interpreting output.

entries.title: HoldemResources documentation
entries.description: Official setup and usage documentation for reproducing a study calculation.
entries.notes: Reading the documentation is distinct from owning or testing the software.

entries.title: ICMIZER and Postflopizer
entries.description: Provider information about preflop and postflop calculation, analysis, and training software.
entries.notes: Subscription software. Product claims and calculation accuracy were not independently tested.

entries.title: PioSOLVER
entries.description: A hold'em solver with links to official getting-started material and tutorials.
entries.notes: Requires careful game-tree and range inputs. No benchmark or accuracy certification is implied.

entries.title: PioSOLVER Quick Start documentation
entries.description: Official documentation introduces the solver interface, building a game tree and browsing a study calculation.
entries.notes: Reading the manual is free; software licensing is separate. No binary, installation advice or calculation was tested.

entries.title: PokerStrategy Equilab
entries.description: Official introduction to hand-versus-range equity calculations, scenarios, and practice features.
entries.notes: The publisher warns against having it open during PokerStars play. Follow each operator's current rules.

entries.title: PokerTracker 4
entries.description: A route to hand-history reports, filters, replays, and post-session analysis documentation.
entries.notes: Listing is for permitted review of your own records. Site support and HUD rules must be checked separately.

entries.title: Bounty models and their assumptions
entries.description: Compare approaches to valuing knockouts, including the distinction between an immediate bounty and future bounty opportunities.
entries.notes: A model explanation from a software provider. Listing the article does not independently validate its models or outputs.

entries.title: Bubble factor in tournaments
entries.description: Study how modeled prize-equity losses and gains affect the risk of a tournament confrontation.

entries.title: Heads-up push/fold reference
entries.description: A heads-up push/fold reference with explanation of the model and how to read the tables.
entries.notes: Heads-up and restricted-action scope. Do not apply it as a six-player tournament solution.

entries.title: ICM basics
entries.description: An introduction to tournament prize equity, risk premiums, and the independent chip model's limitations.
entries.notes: A model explanation is not a verified answer to an incompletely recorded hand.

entries.title: ICM equity calculator
entries.description: Explore modeled prize equity from stacks and payouts using the provider's browser calculator.
entries.notes: The calculator interface was inspected, not independently validated. Use for study after play.

entries.title: Mystery bounties: stages, average prizes, and ICM
entries.description: Understand when bounties activate, how remaining prizes affect average bounty value, and how the format differs from PKOs.
entries.notes: Use the actual event structure. The article's examples and commercial tool links are not a verified solution to your hand.

entries.title: PLO tournaments: structures and strategic adjustments
entries.description: Read how antes, multiway play and stack depth can change Omaha tournament hand selection and betting compared with cash games.
entries.notes: The discussed structure includes a big blind ante; not all PLO events do. Paid-course and gambling promotions are separate.

entries.title: Satellite Masterclass: course outline
entries.description: Inspect a structured satellite course covering early play, the endgame, ICM concepts, and postflop examples.
entries.notes: Paid course. Only the public syllabus and access offer were inspected; lessons, teaching quality, and results were not assessed.

entries.title: Satellite strategy: equal-prize tournament decisions
entries.description: Compare ordinary tournament incentives with equal-seat satellites using explicit stack and payout examples.
entries.notes: Covers multi-seat satellites, not winner-take-all or target-stack formats. Examples are model-dependent; follow event timing rules.

entries.title: Tournament formats explained
entries.description: Look up tournament formats and structures before comparing apparently similar events.
entries.notes: Descriptions are operator-specific; verify the actual event's terms.

entries.title: Badugi rules and showdown comparisons
entries.description: Look up the deal, drawing rounds, hand comparison, and the treatment of incomplete four-card hands.
entries.notes: Rules reference rather than strategy instruction. Confirm local variations before using it to interpret a particular event.

entries.title: Badugi: an introduction to hand strength and draws
entries.description: A signed introduction to complete and incomplete badugis, drawing strength, and how drawing history changes a range.
entries.notes: Published in 2020. Strategy commentary, not a solved chart; the publisher also carries gambling promotions.

entries.title: Deuce-to-seven triple draw rules
entries.description: Explains three drawing rounds, standing pat, and lowball rankings in which aces, straights and flushes matter.
entries.notes: Do not import ace-to-five low rankings from razz or Omaha hi-lo. This is triple draw, not single draw.

entries.title: Deuce-to-seven triple draw: breaking on the turn
entries.description: A focused discussion of keeping or breaking a pat hand when facing aggression after the second draw.
entries.notes: Published in 2023. This is an opponent-dependent decision discussion, separate from the starting-hand article.

entries.title: Deuce-to-seven triple draw: starting hands
entries.description: Study distinctions among pat hands and drawing hands, with position and future draw quality kept in view.
entries.notes: Published in 2020. The author's strategic judgments depend on the stated game and opponents; not universal opening ranges.

entries.title: Double-board bomb pots and multiway incentives
entries.description: An introduction to two-board pots, shared defense and how more opponents alter a betting decision.
entries.notes: Teaching discussion based on a provider webinar. Its examples are not universal ranges for every bomb-pot variant.

entries.title: Eight-game mix: games and rotation
entries.description: Lists the eight component games and explains changes in the game and betting structure.
entries.notes: The published rotation timing belongs to this operator. Live events can use a different number of hands or a different order.

entries.title: Five-card Omaha rules
entries.description: Explains five private cards while retaining exactly two hole cards and three board cards at showdown.
entries.notes: Not interchangeable with four-card Omaha ranges. Check whether the actual game is high-only or split-pot and pot-limit or another structure.

entries.title: HORSE and its rotation
entries.description: An introduction to the component games and rotation in HORSE.

entries.title: Lowball: ace-to-five, deuce-to-seven, and other systems
entries.description: Compare low-hand ranking systems and draw-game variations instead of assuming that every lowball game ranks hands alike.
entries.notes: Different conventions treat aces, straights, and flushes differently. Use the section for the game actually being studied.

entries.title: Mixed-game rotations and component games
entries.description: A compact map of HORSE, eight-game, ten-game, and dealer's-choice variants, including split-pot draw games.
entries.notes: A companion reference, not an organizer's rulebook. Agree the specific rotation and local rules separately.

entries.title: Omaha hi-lo: hand construction and low qualification
entries.description: Explains exactly two hole cards, the eight-or-better low qualifier, and splitting or scooping the pot.
entries.notes: Operator rules page, not a strategy chart. High and low can use different card combinations; confirm the exact variant and betting structure.

entries.title: Omaha high-low and related variations
entries.description: Use the high-low and variations sections to distinguish qualifying lows, hole-card requirements, and alternative Omaha structures.
entries.notes: This complements the existing basic Omaha link with variant detail. The actual game rules still control.

entries.title: Omaha rules
entries.description: Read how four-card Omaha uses hole cards and community cards to form a hand.
entries.notes: Do not import hold'em hand-selection rules without checking the variant.

entries.title: Pagat poker game directory
entries.description: A broad card-game reference with poker variants, rules, and further reading.
entries.notes: A general reference, not the governing rules for a particular cardroom.

entries.title: Razz rules
entries.description: An introduction to a stud-format lowball game and its hand-ranking conventions.

entries.title: Seven-card stud hi-lo rules
entries.description: A street-by-street introduction to stud eight-or-better, including the low qualifier and split-pot showdown.
entries.notes: Stud hand construction differs from Omaha. This page describes this operator's game, not a universal live-room procedure.

entries.title: Seven-card stud: a live cardroom rule reference
entries.description: A concise cardroom reference for antes, the bring-in, exposed cards and later betting rounds.
entries.notes: Room-specific rules and examples. Publication does not establish that this game is currently running or available at a particular limit.

entries.title: Six-plus hold'em: short-deck differences
entries.description: Documents a 36-card deck, button-blind structure and changed rankings for this short-deck format.
entries.notes: These rankings are operator-specific: a flush beats a full house and A-6-7-8-9 is a straight here. Confirm local rules rather than assuming all short-deck games match.

entries.title: Andrew Neeme: What I am studying
entries.description: A poker vlogger explains the questions, hand discussions, training and tools behind his study process.
entries.notes: Historical February 2020 essay with commercial links. Product offers are not current recommendations; use any study tools after play.

entries.title: Brad Owen: inside the WPT World Championship
entries.description: The tour's introduction and link to Owen's episode 323, documenting a World Championship tournament run.
entries.notes: January 2025 feature about the 2024 event, not a current schedule. Companion text inspected; full video not watched.

entries.title: Crush Live Poker videos
entries.description: A video catalogue covering live hold'em, Omaha, split-pot games, and hand analysis.
entries.notes: Much of the library needs a membership; free-labelled material can have access conditions.

entries.title: Jaman Burton hand breakdown with Jonathan Little
entries.description: A written and video-linked breakdown of a live cash-game hand, connecting a vlogger's action to a separate review.
entries.notes: Historical Weekly Poker Hand 428 article. Written analysis inspected, not complete video playback; strategic conclusions remain the author's.

entries.title: James Sweeney interview: learning and coaching, with transcript
entries.description: A published interview with James Sweeney about poker learning and coaching, accompanied by a public text transcript.
entries.notes: Episode page and transcript inspected; audio was not independently listened to. Personal views and promotional links are not independently tested coaching results.

entries.title: Lexy Gavin-Mather: blog and vlog companions
entries.description: Browse tournament stories, hand discussions and written context accompanying a creator's poker videos.
entries.notes: Public article index inspected, not every linked video. Coaching and other paid offers are separate.

entries.title: MIT: How to Win at Texas Hold'em Poker (2016)
entries.description: A distinct hold'em course with video lectures, slides, problem sets, and supporting study materials.
entries.notes: The title is the course title, not this directory's promise. Historical instruction; catalogue inspected, not all videos watched.

entries.title: PokerGO viewing library
entries.description: The broadcaster's home for poker shows, event coverage, and viewing information.
entries.notes: Subscription, region, and individual-program availability may vary. Playback was not tested.

entries.title: PokerNews podcasts
entries.description: Poker interviews, discussion, and show archives in audio and video formats.
entries.notes: A route to the publisher's shows, not a claim that every episode has been reviewed.

entries.title: Red Chip Poker podcast archive
entries.description: Strategy audio and show notes organized by episode.
entries.notes: The publisher identifies subscriber-only material alongside the public archive.

entries.title: Smart Poker Study podcast and show notes
entries.description: Find study routines, hand-reading exercises and post-session review topics through an organized episode archive.
